---
title: "Change Log"
---

## Summary so far

As of 2026-09-26, the copied BCFMS/MS codebase has been replaced by a PPSV
repository delivery. The new app is branded for PPSV, starts from a fresh
database, uses the PPSV service modules and inquiry flow, stores requests with
the shared `PPSV000001` sequence, records the required status/history/mail/file
metadata, and excludes the old MS cost, invoice, sample-table, and data-release
workflows.

The repository now contains the Shiny app, database migrations, tests,
deployment and provisioning scripts, Apache/Shiny templates, backup and restore
helpers, example non-secret configuration, and this operator guide. The code was
verified locally with R parsing, testthat tests, shell syntax checks, Quarto
rendering, and a browser smoke test.

Production activation is still gated on four administrator-owned items: the
matching TLS private key, authorization of `ppsv-service@biochem.mpg.de`, a real
ticket auto-reply/requester test, and an external backup destination plus pool
snapshot policy.

## Latest repository changes

- Added PPSV-specific Shiny modules, database schema, validation, PDF export,
  mail outbox, file storage, authorization, and admin views.
- Added idempotent provisioning, deployment, rollback, verification, backup,
  restore, pool reconciliation, and mail-processing scripts.
- Added PPSV operator documentation covering setup, fields, LDAP, SMTP,
  storage, TLS, backup/restore, acceptance, troubleshooting, and local
  development.
- Removed the copied MS runtime assumptions from the delivered application:
  production uses a fresh PPSV database and does not migrate `ms_projects.db`.
